metadata.title: Admin Dashboard
metadata.description: Provider governance dashboard for Bharosa Hai admins.

hero.title: Provider governance that feels calm and operational.
hero.copy: The admin surface is styled for repeated review work: clear status, readable tables, restrained actions and no visual mismatch with the public website.

list.title: Review provider applications.
list.copy: This dashboard now reads provider applications directly from the database.

secure.title: Secure admin-only access
secure.copy: Admin access is protected by a server-side access token while the full auth provider is prepared.

timeline.title: Open application
timeline.copy: Review identity, profile, category, experience and city.

timeline.title: Choose decision
timeline.copy: Approve, reject or ask for more documents.

timeline.title: Record audit trail
timeline.copy: Admin decisions are saved with a traceable system record.

checklist.title: A structured review flow for admins.
